cohort: 300 women with a live singleton fetus in the cephalic presentation, induced at term (37 weeks), delivering at a hospital in Patna, Bihar, over one year.
finding: Maternal age ≥35 years, BMI ≥30 kg/m2, nulliparity, preinduction Bishops score <5, gestational diabetes mellitus, and intrauterine growth restriction were significantly associated with cesarean delivery.
